evaluations.name: positive_incident_detection
evaluations.input_prompt: Cluster Autoscaler on dbs-mgmt-primary is reporting scale-up stalls. Inspect autoscaler status configmap and node pool boundaries.
expected_tools: kubectl get cm -n kube-system cluster-autoscaler-status -o yaml

expected_findings.root_cause: Decoded autoscaler decision tree; verified whether scale-up stalls stem from maxNodeCount limit or unmatchable pod selectors.
expected_findings.remediation: Synthesize `gcloud container clusters update --enable-autoscaling --max-nodes` command to increase capacity ceiling.

passing_criteria: Must inspect nodePool autoscaling parameters across all pools
Must formulate exact gcloud command adjusting max-nodes

evaluations.name: complex_edge_case_and_handoff
evaluations.input_prompt: Cluster Autoscaler attempted scale-up but node group creation failed. Determine whether failure is quota-related or autoscaler logic.
expected_tools: kubectl get cm -n kube-system cluster-autoscaler-status -o yaml
gcloud compute regions describe asia-southeast1 --flatten='quotas[]' --format='table(quotas.metric,quotas.usage,quotas.limit)' | grep NVIDIA

expected_findings.correlation: Correlates autoscaler event log (`scaleUp: NoCandidates` or Cloud Provider error) with regional GPU quota saturation.
expected_findings.decision: Identifies that autoscaler attempted scale-up but Compute Engine API rejected instance group resize due to quota; routes to `gcp-compute-quota-troubleshooting`.

passing_criteria: Must correlate autoscaler status with Compute Engine quota
Must distinguish GKE autoscaler policy from GCP infrastructure limit
Must recommend quota request rather than autoscaler reconfiguration

evaluations.name: benign_condition_guardrail
evaluations.input_prompt: Cluster dbs-mgmt-primary has autoscaler status Healthy and 0 pending pods. Is autoscaling degraded?
expected_tools: kubectl get cm -n kube-system cluster-autoscaler-status -o jsonpath='{.data.status}'

expected_findings.behavior: Observes autoscalerStatus: Running, clusterWide status: Healthy, scaleUp status: NoActivity. Confirms normal state; zero actions.

passing_criteria: Must confirm clusterWide health is Healthy
